name: smwmusic-jump-the-trap-doors-redux
title: JUMP½ - The Trap Doors (Redux)
description:
A remake/redux of an edgy song for a level all about "trap doors". Unlike the repetitive nature of the original, this version changes up a fair bit. Useful for castles with a more exciting atmosphere, or possibly airships.

This song omits Yoshi, Thunder, P-switch, and Bonus end.

Original version here.

Special thanks to the people who wanted a release of this version of the track in the comments of this video. Due to limits, the lack of echo and some percussion sample changes had to be made. This is, in fact, the intended version of the song I wished had been included. At the very least, the song is not lost. Happy (Late) Halloween!
